name: personal-tutor
description: Local tutoring skill with interactive courses and practice.

scripts.build: rm -rf packages/tutor-kit/dist && tsc -b packages/tutor-kit --force && chmod +x packages/tutor-kit/dist/cli/index.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/server/*.test.ts
scripts.examples:check: npm run build && node packages/tutor-kit/dist/cli/index.js --cwd examples doctor
scripts.examples:dev: npm run build && node packages/tutor-kit/dist/cli/index.js --cwd examples dev
